description: Events956 source registry. Every sweep iterates this file. method: rss|ical|gcal|page (plain fetch), browser (needs real Chrome — Cloudflare/JS), browser-public (Facebook logged-out), websearch (general search), submission-only (no public calendar; rely on outreach/submissions). priority: 1=every sweep, 2=weekly, 3=occasional.

sources.name: MyRGV.com (The Monitor / Valley Morning Star / Brownsville Herald)
sources.notes: WordPress RSS, updates hourly; mine event-roundup articles. Events calendar page is Cloudflare-blocked — use RSS.

sources.name: KRGV Channel 5 News
sources.notes: Event coverage + community calendar via search.

sources.name: ValleyCentral (KGBT/KVEO)
sources.notes: Things-to-do roundups.

sources.name: Telemundo 40
sources.notes: Spanish-language event coverage.

sources.name: KTEX 100.1 (radio)
sources.notes: Concert/community calendar; proved useful for Parade of Homes and Hunters Expo.

sources.name: City of Edinburg / Edinburg Arts
sources.notes: Summer concert series etc.

sources.name: Visit Harlingen / City of Harlingen
sources.notes: Jackson Street Market Days at harlingentx.gov.

sources.name: City of Brownsville / Visit Brownsville
sources.notes: Parks & rec newsflash feed useful.

sources.name: McAllen Chamber of Commerce
sources.notes: Also hosts 1 Million Cups listing.

sources.name: RunSignup
sources.notes: Official registration pages = verified:true.

sources.name: RunningInTheUSA
sources.notes: Parameterized URLs: /classic/list/{distance}/within-{miles}-miles-of-{city}-tx/sort-by-open-date/{month}. Cloudflare — needs Chrome extension. Verify each race on its own site.

sources.name: TrainerDay Events
sources.notes: Mostly duplicates RunSignup; unreliable locations. Backup only.

sources.name: Eventbrite RGV
sources.notes: Search per city.

sources.name: AllEvents.in
sources.notes: Secondary aggregator; verify before publish.

sources.name: Facebook public event search
sources.notes: Works logged OUT — no account involved. Iterate all 8 cities. Capture 'interested/going' counts as attendance signals. confidence:low until cross-verified (reseller spam common).

sources.name: UTRGV Events Calendar
sources.notes: Localist platform — check /api/2/events for JSON API.

sources.name: NHPO RGV
sources.notes: Site stale; real announcements on FB (facebook.com/NHPOintheRGV) + Texas Border Business. Monthly networking every 3rd Thursday 6-9pm. Check FB public page during sweeps; outreach candidate.

sources.name: South Texas Builders Association (Cameron-Willacy)
sources.notes: Distinct from RGVBA. Gallery of Homes, banquets, fishing tournament.

sources.name: RGV Builders Association (Hidalgo-Starr)
sources.notes: LeadConnector calendar with categories; Parade of Homes.

sources.name: Rotary District 5930
sources.notes: Club directory at /clubdirectory/ indexes all RGV clubs.

sources.name: Rotary Club of Harlingen
sources.notes: Active ClubRunner calendar. Meets Fridays 12pm.

sources.name: McAllen Evening Rotary
sources.notes: Live calendar; main McAllen Rotary site is defunct (meets Wed 12pm Pasta Cafe per district).

sources.name: Brownsville Rotary clubs
sources.notes: Also: rotarybrownsvillehistoric.org, northbrownsvillerotary.org, brownsvillesunriserotarytx.org.

sources.name: JustUs (RGV)
sources.notes: No verifiable public presence found — likely private FB/word-of-mouth group. NEED: direct link from Juan.

sources.name: 1 Million Cups McAllen
sources.notes: Weekly Wed mornings, McAllen Creative Incubator. National 1MC site is scrape-hostile; chamber listing + FB (facebook.com/1MCMcAllen) are the practical sources.

sources.name: McAllen ISD
sources.notes: Apptegy, JS-rendered; no full iCal. Athletics at /athletics.

sources.name: Edinburg CISD
sources.notes: Edlio — exposes iCal/ICS subscribe. Grab feed URL from calendar subscribe control on first ingest.

sources.name: PSJA ISD
sources.notes: Finalsite — standard iCal subscribe; verify feed URL on first ingest.

sources.name: Mission CISD
sources.notes: Edlio — confirmed Google/iCal/ICS subscribe.

sources.name: Harlingen CISD
sources.notes: Apptegy, JS-rendered; per-event export only.

sources.name: Brownsville ISD
sources.notes: Tandem master calendar with subscribe (iCal/Google) + school/dept filters — best district feed.

sources.name: Saint Joseph Academy (Brownsville)
sources.notes: Public Google Calendar with GCal + ICS subscribe links. Fundraisers at /support-sja/special-events.

sources.name: Marine Military Academy (Harlingen)
sources.notes: Calendar is PDF-only; public events (Birthday Ball, parades) announced on site + FB.

sources.name: Juan Diego Academy (Mission)
sources.notes: Static calendar page; FB most active. Athletics on MaxPreps.
